# WebcamClicks

> Free online webcam effects studio, 60fps video recorder, photo booth collages, mobile cinema camera, and mic testing tool. 100% private in-browser client-side WebRTC processing with zero server uploads.

WebcamClicks (https://webcamclicks.com/) is a modern, privacy-first web application designed as the superior, ad-clean alternative to legacy tools like Webcam Toy. It runs entirely inside any modern web browser using client-side WebRTC, Canvas 2D, and WebAudio technologies without requiring accounts, signups, cookies, or software installations.

## Core Tools & Direct URLs

- [Webcam Studio (Homepage)](https://webcamclicks.com/): Primary camera studio featuring 80+ visual filters (Cyber Glitch, 80s Retrowave, VHS, Super 8, Prism Flare, Pop Art, Vintage Kodachrome), live 60 FPS video recording with microphone audio sync, 4-pose photo booth collage strips, mirror mode, digital zoom (up to 8x), and motion-controlled camera games.
- [Professional Cinema Camera](https://webcamclicks.com/pro-camera): Mobile-first cinema camera web app featuring theatrical movie aspect ratios (1.85:1 Flat, 2.39:1 Scope, 16:9, 4:3 Vintage Box, IMAX 1.43:1 and 1.90:1), 60 FPS video recording, live microphone decibel VU meter, 35mm LUT color profiles (REC.709, ScopeX, Portra 35mm, Tri-X Noir, Golden Hour, Cyberpunk, Glitch, Anamorphic Flare, Super 8), and tap-to-focus reticle.
- [Webcam Toy Alternative](https://webcamclicks.com/webcam-toy-alternative): Comprehensive comparison and upgrade guide over Webcam Toy. Explains modern advantages: full HD/4K resolution (vs 640x480), video recording capability, photo booth collages, mobile responsiveness, and zero third-party ads.
- [Microphone Tester](https://webcamclicks.com/mic-test): Free online mic tester featuring live decibel (dB) level meter, frequency spectrum visualizer, pitch detection, and instant voice playback recording.
- [Dual Webcam Compare](https://webcamclicks.com/compare-webcams): Side-by-side split-screen comparison of two connected webcams or video input devices with latency, sharpness, and color grading inspection.
- [International Language Hub](https://webcamclicks.com/languages): Multilingual hubs localized in Spanish (/es/), French (/fr/), German (/de/), Portuguese (/pt/), and Hindi (/hi/).

## Key Capabilities & Technical Specifications

- **Frame Rate**: Up to 60 FPS live preview and video recording on supported webcams, iPhones (including iPhone 14 Pro / 15 Pro / 16 Pro), and Android devices.
- **Recording Formats**: Hardware-accelerated MP4 (H.264 / AVC1) on iOS/macOS and WebM (VP9/VP8/Opus) on Windows, Android, and Linux.
- **Security & Privacy**: Zero cloud uploads. All video frames, photos, audio tracks, and recordings are processed in volatile memory on the user's local device. Fully GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA compliant.
- **Photo Booth Strips**: Built-in 4-pose sequential photo booth with countdown timer, theme borders (Classic White, Dark Noir, Cyber Neon, Retro Gold), and instant PNG download.
- **Motion Games**: Frame-differencing motion tracker games (Motion Catch, Face Pong, Freeze Pose) playable using physical body movement without large ML model downloads.
- **Device Support**: Fully responsive across mobile smartphones (iOS Safari, Android Chrome), tablets, laptops, and desktop computers.
